decision_record.mechanism: Unpriced risk / execution: select_debit_spread never reads the short leg's ask; a blown-out short quote passes the debit cap (debit uses bid only) while the exit cost is unknowable.
decision_record.transfer: The debit spread's edge is paid at the exit cross: entry debit is priced off the short leg's bid, exit value off its ask, so an unpriced short-leg spread is a direct leak from entry to exit.
